== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Undercover (Japanese)|Undercover]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67690 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(50, 16, 430, 612)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>48f56cbe8ef1a2406c426a1431575f31cc2fe95249c914863802827699b31c97</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
